Astra 0.1.0 provides distributed service discovery and state synchronization.

## Components

- Star: replicated Almanac, Catalog and Ephemeris views.
- Pulsar: infrastructure admission, persistent membership and continuous time.
- Polaris: persistent configuration authority.
- Astrolabe: authenticated management HTTP API.
- Comet C++ and Go application SDKs.

## Downloads

Download `astra-0.1.0-linux-x86_64.tar.gz`, `build-manifest.json` and `SHA256SUMS` together. Run `sha256sum --check SHA256SUMS` before extraction.

The Linux x86-64 archive includes all four services, Comet C++ development files, matching GCC runtimes, public guides and license notices. See [deployment](https://github.com/eosforge/astra/blob/v0.1.0/docs/deployment.md) and [C++ SDK setup](https://github.com/eosforge/astra/blob/v0.1.0/comet/cpp/README.md).

The [Go SDK](https://github.com/eosforge/astra/blob/v0.1.0/comet/go/README.md) is a separate source module: `go get github.com/eosforge/astra/comet/go@v0.1.0`.

## Compatibility and validation

Binaries target Linux x86-64 using GCC 16.2.0 on Debian 13. The manifest records source identity, libc requirements, file hashes and linkage. The C++ SDK requires matching external development dependencies. No Windows binary is included.

The packaging workflow checks installed linkage and uploaded checksums with product tests disabled. The manifest contains the actual file inventory. Local verification on 2026-10-23 covered Go/C++ selections, three-Star recovery, ten minutes of installed-runtime work and twelve short performance samples; see [the changelog](https://github.com/eosforge/astra/blob/v0.1.0/CHANGELOG.md#validation-summary) for results, the retained ASan/UBSan timeout and TSan interruption, and remaining failures. These local observations do not establish that the downloaded archive passed product tests. Full release qualification remains blocked; tags are unsigned.

This republication replaces the earlier 0.1.0 source and assets. Download the archive, manifest and checksums as one set. Public C++ enum items now use PascalCase without compatibility aliases; rebuild callers using older spellings. Existing Go module caches or checksum records can still refer to earlier `v0.1.0` bytes; see [republication compatibility](https://github.com/eosforge/astra/blob/v0.1.0/docs/releases.md#republication-compatibility).

Polaris is a single persistent authority. Catalog and Ephemeris hold finite-lifetime memory data. Admin, Planet and Moon are outside this release. See [release scope](https://github.com/eosforge/astra/blob/v0.1.0/docs/releases.md).

Owned code and documentation use MIT; third-party notices and runtime exceptions still apply.
